context: M23 o7. Rita's bar after close. Tina at the end of the bar, makeup off.

lines.speaker: char.tina_mercado
lines.text: Del. Lonnie's my cousin. My mother's sister's kid. I been telling him things.

lines.speaker: char.tina_mercado
lines.text: Sunday nights. Where the box was. The eleven hundred went to his lawyer.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: I covered for that eleven hundred, Tina. Out of my own pocket. Nobody knows.

lines.speaker: char.tina_mercado
lines.text: I know. That's why I'm telling you. I'm tired of rules. I'm tired of him.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Come here. Rule one still stands. Count everything. Including friends.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Sunday you tell the table. All of it. Then they decide. Not me.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: I'll put the eleven hundred back. My shop money. The count will be clean.

lines.speaker: char.tina_mercado
lines.text: I'm gonna do hair, Del. Hair don't hit you. Hair don't ask for a cut.
